title: Memory: from one chat to the team
sub: The fourth film of Agents at work on data, the second series on AI agents in data work: what one person's agent learns in a chat stays there, and a colleague's agent repeats the mistake; a session is an episode, and lasting memory keeps the facts, preferences and decisions it teaches; memory the team shares, reviewed, without names and corrected when wrong, lets every agent learn from every chat.
howto: The film is drawn in the module's look: a pale marble wall over an oak floor, light from a window on the right. The agent is a ceramic sphere with a violet band, never a person. Blue is a tool, violet the model, orange the data and its evidence, green what is checked and agrees, amber a slip or a doubt. The places of the opening story are painted full-frame, matte and soft-lit, with the place and year on a tag.
